hero.title: Find real people, not an endless feed of profiles
hero.subtitle: Every profile passes video verification. AI helps you put into words who you are looking for and brings 3–5 meaningful matches a day — instead of endless swiping.
hero.note: Free to start. Video verification takes about a minute.
hero.imageAlt: Two people laughing together in a warm cafe light

why.title: Why it is not like everywhere else
why.subtitle: Three principles we build the product around.

real.title: Real people only
real.text: Mandatory video verification. No bots, no stolen photos, no empty profiles.

ai.title: AI that listens, not swipes
ai.text: It helps you state your intent precisely and matches by meaning, not by an endless card stack.

meet.title: From chatting to meeting
meet.text: Events and shared activities move you from a chat window to real life.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Four steps from sign-up to a real conversation.

s1.title: Verification
s1.text: A short video check confirms you are you.

s2.title: Tell the AI about yourself
s2.text: A calm dialogue instead of a long form.

s4.title: Move to real communication
s4.text: Chat, a call, an event — at your pace.

trust.title: Trust and safety
trust.subtitle: Openness is a feature, not a setting hidden in a menu.

moderation.title: Live moderation
moderation.text: People and automation review reports around the clock.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.text: We never sell data and never share it with advertisers.

visibility.title: You control visibility
visibility.text: Decide who sees your profile, photos and city.
